Short NetLogo reference summaries for official inSTREAM 7.4 examples.

Generated with NetLogo 7.0.2 headless from the public
`InSTREAM-7.4_2026-02-11.zip` distribution, then aggregated from
`BriefPopOut-*.csv` with `openlimno ibm-summarize-instream7-brief`.

These are short two-day calibration fixtures for native-vs-NetLogo smoke
comparison. They are not long-run regulatory calibration targets.
